shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la; cat package.json; cat src/App.tsx; cat src/index.css; cat src/main.tsx; find .. -name AGENTS.md -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -55; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts; cat index.html; cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | rg '(TextInput|PasswordInput|Provider|Button|TextControl|Alert).*d.ts"'$'"' | head -50; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Provider/Provider.d.ts; rg 'export.*(ArrowRight|ArrowUpRight|CircleQuestion|Lock|Globe|Xmark|Envelope|ShieldCheck)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -25; ls node_modules | rg 'playwright|puppeteer'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/Provider.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/common/types.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts | head -100'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for (const p of ['playwright','@playwright/test','puppeteer']) {try {console.log(p,import.meta.resolve(p))}catch{}}\"; ls /tmp; git diff --stat; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/fonts.css | head -25; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.js | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import {chromium} from '/tmp/gravity-check/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs'; const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true}); const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1440,height:1000},deviceScaleFactor:1}); await page.goto('http://localhost:5175'); await page.screenshot({path:'/tmp/gravity-desktop.png',fullPage:true}); console.log(await page.title()); await browser.close();\""

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/gravity-libs
cd /tmp/gravity-libs
apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libgbm1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0
for pkg in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$pkg" extracted; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/gravity-libs
apt-get download libavahi-common3 libavahi-client3 libdrm2 libwayland-server0 libpixman-1-0 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 libxcb-shm0 libxcb-render0 libxrender1 libfribidi0 libthai0 libharfbuzz0b libxi6 libdatrie1 libgraphite2-3 libbrotli1
for pkg in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$pkg" extracted; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1254/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg '"'not found'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/gravity-libs
apt-get download fontconfig-config fonts-liberation
for pkg in fontconfig-config*.deb fonts-liberation*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$pkg" extracted; done
FONTCONFIG_PATH=/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/etc/fonts LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu DEBUG=pw:browser node /tmp/gravity-check/check.mjs > /tmp/gravity-browser.log 2>&1
rg -n '"'FATAL|ERROR|Error|PASS|error:' /tmp/gravity-browser.log | head -15"

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/gravity-libs
apt-get download libsqlite3-0
for pkg in libsqlite3-0*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$pkg" extracted; done
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/gravity-libs/fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/gravity-check/check.mjs'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build; git diff --check; git status --short'
